rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone employed to manage and oversee a household.

example.english: They are our housekeeper, responsible for managing the domestic staff and daily household chores.
example.traditional: 佢係我哋屋企嘅管家，負責安排工人同打理日常家務。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 dei6 uk1 kei2 ge3 gun2 gaa1 fu6 zaak3 on1 paai4 gung1 jan4 tung4 daa2 lei5 jat6 soeng4 gaa1 mou6

rows.note: Use this for a paid household worker who mainly does domestic tasks rather than manages other servants.

example.english: I hired a housekeeper to come twice a week to clean and cook for us.
example.traditional: 我請咗個家務助理，每個星期嚟兩日幫我哋清潔同煮飯。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ceng2 zo2 go3 gaa1 mou6 zo6 lei5 mui5 go3 sing1 kei4 lai4 loeng5 jat6 bong1 ngo5 dei6 cing1 git3 tung4 zyu2 faan6

rows.note: Use this for housekeeping staff in a hotel or other institution.

example.english: The hotel housekeeper cleans the rooms one by one every morning.
example.traditional: 酒店房務員每日朝早會逐間房清潔。
example.jyutping: zau2 dim3 fong4 mou6 jyun4 mui5 jat6 ziu1 zou2 wui5 zuk6 gaan1 fong4 cing1 git3
